title: Derivatives parallel to the boundary integrate to zero over a half-space
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, v, u ∈ ℝ^P with ⟨u, v⟩ = 0, and h : ℝ^P → ℝ of class C¹ with compact support. Then ∫_H Dh(w)(u) dL^P(w) = 0, where H := {w ∈ ℝ^P : ⟨w, v⟩ > 0}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (v u : Euclid P) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), inner ℝ u v = 0 → ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ w in {w : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ w v}, fderiv ℝ h w u = 0
